newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-BAD BOY BRITONS BANNED FROM ELITE TRAINING.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-BAD BOY BRITONS BANNED FROM ELITE TRAINING.

text.p: Two teenaged English badminton players have been removed from the national training squad as punishment for various incidents at the sports national centre, it was announced on Thursday.
Ian Sullivan, 19, has been taken out of national training for the whole of February and will not be funded for events in March.
Nathan Robertson, also 19, who has been in trouble with officialdom before, has been taken out of national training and will not be funded to events for an indefinite period.

The decisions were taken by Badminton Association of England director of elite play, Steve Baddeley, and national coach, Asger Madsen. Baddeley said: An off-court culture has developed in English badminton that is counter-productive to achieving world class performance.

In September, Robertson, who is seen as one of the brightest talents to emerge for some time, was dropped from the national squad for two internationals for breaching Baddeleys tough new rules on drinking. English badminton has been through a poor spell of late, but Baddeley is striving for an upturn in fortunes along with Madsen and ex-top world doubles player Park Joo-bong of South Korea who is joining the coaching staff.
